replies.author: fisj
replies.body: TLDR. Its an incredible model from the standpoint that its fast, small, and the license is highly permissive. The generations are not what people would call usable, but there are usecases where this will open up new possibilities even at this early stage. I expect to see serious improvement in 3d generation over the next year.
